wallet.unsupportedNetwork: Your wallet is connected to an unsupported network.

verifyErrors.generic: Wallet verification failed. Check the signature request and try again.
verifyErrors.INVALID_INJECTIVE_ADDRESS: This wallet address is not supported. Connect an Injective-compatible EVM wallet and try again.
verifyErrors.CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND: The verification request was not found. Select Verify wallet again to get a new one.
verifyErrors.CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: The verification request expired or was already used. Select Verify wallet again and sign the new message.
verifyErrors.INVALID_SIGNATURE: The signature does not match this wallet. Sign with the connected address and try again.
verifyErrors.WALLET_ALREADY_LINKED: This wallet is already linked to another account, or your account already has a wallet. A linked wallet cannot be changed here. If it is the wrong one, or it belongs to another account, contact the Ninja Labs team.
verifyErrors.AGENT_WALLET_IS_OWNER_WALLET: This address is already used as the wallet of one of your agents. Connect a different personal wallet for your account.
verifyErrors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
verifyErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
